scope: Disposable PostgreSQL 16 with migrations 335 and 374 applied in order; the ClickHouse client was controlled in-process and no live ClickHouse/provider endpoint was contacted.

checks.docker_resources: temporary container and network removed; no volume created

behaviors: enqueue rollback leaves no outbox row
same event key is idempotent and conflicting payloads are rejected
disabled provider does not consume a retry attempt
expired lease can be reclaimed while stale-owner completion is rejected
unavailable transport reaches the bounded dead-letter state
operator replay succeeds once and duplicate replay is rejected
one-shot CLI reports provider setup failure with exit code 1 and persists a retryable attempt
one-shot CLI reports successful controlled delivery with exit code 0 and persists success

test_environment.provider: in-process controlled success/failure; no live ClickHouse service
test_environment.network_note: Docker Desktop host-port publication required attaching the temporary fixture to the default bridge as well as its temporary internal network; no claim of network isolation is made.
test_environment.secret_handling: synthetic database password supplied through the process environment and not recorded

limitations: This verifies PostgreSQL persistence and one-shot process exit behavior, not ClickHouse availability, cross-store crash deduplication, live provider interoperability, or long-duration operation.
No Raspberry Pi hardware was available; this fixture does not claim ARM device behavior.
The temporary Docker fixture was removed after acceptance; no volume was created.
